name: public-nl2sql-expert-base
summary: NL2SQL/Text2SQL 知识基座：两阶段架构(NL2DSL2SQL)、查询类型分类、字段/术语映射、条件与 metric 抽取、多表 JOIN 推理、SQL 正确性与评测。供 devlab-nl2sql-engineering 通过 extends 继承。
runtime_requirements: This is a knowledge base skill, designed to be extended via the extends mechanism.
Prefer measured evidence (评测集正确率/EXPLAIN) over blanket rules.
Distinguish 表象修复 vs 根因修复; avoid symptom-only patches.
Ask for explicit human approval before destructive schema/data operations.
post_install_hints: Typically hidden from IDE listings and merged into extending skills.
Load reference files per topic area as needed.
